- [ ] I followed the agent template structure in `templates/copilot-studio-agent-template.md` (if adding an agent)

- [ ] Section headings match the style of existing files in the same directory
- [ ] If I added or renamed an agent, I updated `/diagrams/multi-agent-map.mermaid`
- [ ] If I changed workflow logic, I updated the relevant agent spec's approval checkpoints
- [ ] If I added new approval items, they are consistent with `templates/approval-pattern.md`
